prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Charlotte after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Charlotte for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you specific law firm recommendations — but first I need two quick clarifying things so the list is useful for your situation:

1. Do you want a large national firm (often lots of resources) or a smaller local boutique (often more personal attention)?  
2. A brief case snapshot: roughly when the crash happened, whether you were injured (and how seriously), and whether insurance/at-fault status is clear. (If you’d rather not share details here, that’s fine — I can still give a solid general list.)

While you decide, here are immediate things to do and what to ask any lawyer when you call — this will speed up getting the right help.

Immediate steps (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical care and follow doctors’ orders; document everything.  
- Get the police report number and copies of photos, witness contact info, and any dash-cam/cell videos.  
- Do not give a recorded statement to an insurance company without an attorney.  
- Preserve evidence (car damage photos, clothing, medical bills, receipts).  
- Note all time missed from work and any out-of-pocket expenses.

What to ask when you call a personal-injury lawyer
- Do you handle automobile accident cases in Charlotte/Mecklenburg County? How many auto cases do you take per year?  
- Do you take cases on contingency? What is your fee and are there any other costs I would be responsible for?  
- Do you try cases or primarily settle? Have you gone to trial in Mecklenburg County recently?  
- What is your experience with cases like mine (severity of injury, uninsured/underinsured motorist, multiple vehicles)?  
- Who will handle the day-to-day work (partner, associate, paralegal)? How will I be updated?  
- How long do you think my case might take?  
- Can you provide client references or examples of past results (settlement/verdicts) for similar cases?  
- Do you handle medical lien negotiations and advance medical payments if needed?

How I’ll help if you want me to pick specific firms
- I can prepare a shortlist (3–7 firms) tailored to your preferences (big vs boutique, trial-focused, bilingual, Spanish-speaking staff, etc.) and explain why to call each one (experience, notable results, local reputation, contingency terms).  
- If you want, include the phone numbers and a brief script you can use when you call.

Tell me your preference about firm size and a short case snapshot (or say “don’t share details”) and I’ll give a focused list of Charlotte personal injury firms to call and why.
